thread:
Ashley: Quick sync — Nexus SDK adapter pilot onboarding tomorrow. Putting a short Q&A here so Eng/DevEx/Platform know what to expect. Can folks chime in with answers/owners? :wave:

Maria: Thanks! Main asks from Nexus: auth flow (they prefer OAuth2 with PKCE), telemetry expectations, sample app for marketplace, and compatibility with our function-calling hooks.

Devon: For function-calling — Nexus wants to call a typed tool/agent via our streaming path. We support that, but need to clarify schema enforcement and max payload. Short answer: yes, but we should document the JSON schema limit (~64KB) and show an example.

Kai: On auth, we only support token-based service accounts for marketplace publishing. OAuth PKCE is fine for their end-users, but for the adapter marketplace listing they need a service principal flow. Owner: Kai to draft the required token exchange and sample snippet.

Maria: Noted. Also they asked about telemetry: can they opt out of telemetry in the adapter? We should allow opt-out when customers are private deploys. For hosted, we need anonymized metrics for billing and SLOs. Suggest flag: `send_anonymous_metrics: true|false`.

Devon: Agree. Add a note: opt-out disables non-critical metrics only (latency/cost), we still log errors for debugging (no PII).

Sam: Marketplace certs: Nexus asked about a smoke-test matrix. Proposed tests: connectivity, auth, function-call roundtrip, embedding index small workload, and rate-limit behavior. I'll make a test harness.

Ashley: Perfect. Can we get a concrete checklist? If someone posts a quick checklist I can forward to Nexus PM.

Devon: Draft checklist below:
1) Adapter repo builds and CI passing (`make test` / `pytest`)
2) OAuth/service-account flows documented + example `curl`
3) Function-calling demo that returns typed JSON (<=64KB)
4) Embedding integration sample (chunking config)
5) Telemetry opt-out flag documented
6) Marketplace manifest `marketplace.yaml` + icon assets
7) Security questionnaire answered (data flows, retention, KMS usage)

Maria: Adding small snippets — auth example:
```bash
# exchange code for token (example)
curl -X POST https://nexus.example.com/oauth/token \
  -d "grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&client_id=...&redirect_uri=..."
```
And service account sample for publishing:
```json
{
  "type": "service_account",
  "client_id": "redwood-nexus-pub",
  "private_key": "REDACTED"
}
```

Kai: I'll own the marketplace publishing doc and the service-account sample. ETA EOD.

Ashley: What about compatibility with our routing policies (dedicated vs hosted)? Nexus wants to let customers choose. Any limitations?

Devon: The adapter should be able to configure model pinning via the SDK — we expose route hints in the request header `x-rd-route: dedicated|hosted`. Document default fallback behavior (hosted fallback to a smaller model).

Maria: Also call out rate limits — we throttle adapter calls to protect shared pools. Suggest Nexus expose exponential backoff (header `Retry-After` on 429).

Sam: CI note — testing matrix will run on our infra. deploy-bot just finished their last PR build: `deploy-bot: CI pipeline nexus-adapter #402 passed on staging (1767765501)`.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline nexus-adapter #402 passed — smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:

Ashley: Great. Timeline: Kai (marketplace doc) EOD, Sam (test harness) tomorrow morning, Devon (function-calling example) tomorrow noon, Maria to compile and send to Nexus PM 2026-03-25.

Maria: I'll send a short onboarding packet with the checklist + a minimal sample app repo link once Kai drops the manifest.

Devon: One more gotcha — Nexus uses chunked embeddings (overlapping chunks). Recommend we document our recommended chunk_size/overlap for their indexer. I'll add a small note in the example code.

Maria: Example config snippet:
```yaml
embeddings:
  chunk_size: 1024
  overlap: 128
  model: redwood/sim-embed-1
```

Ashley: Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, reply here. I'll loop in Nexus PM after Kai drops the manifest. :+1:

Sam: assigning tasks in Asana now. I'll link the ticket when done.

Kai: Manifest PR created: https://git.redwood.com/nexus/marketplace-manifest/pull/7 — will add service account example and logo.

Ashley: Awesome. Closing here — follow-ups will be in the PR and Asana ticket.
